mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.rta_match m WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.rta_match m WHERE DATE(m.played_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.rta_match m WHERE m.played_at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_matches, COUNT(DISTINCT r.replay_id) as unique_matches, COUNT(DISTINCT u.wizard_id) as unique_users, COUNT(DISTINCT unit.unit_master_id) as unique_units FROM public.rta_match r LEFT JOIN public.rta_match_participant u ON r.replay_id = u.replay_id LEFT JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick unit ON r.replay_id = unit.replay_id LIMIT 1

SELECT r.replay_id AS rid, r.battle_type, r.played_at AS date_add, COUNT(DISTINCT u.wizard_id) as player_count, COUNT(DISTINCT unit.unit_master_id) as unit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT unit.wizard_id) as pick_count FROM public.rta_match r LEFT JOIN public.rta_match_participant u ON r.replay_id = u.replay_id LEFT JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick unit ON r.replay_id = unit.replay_id GROUP BY r.replay_id, r.battle_type, r.played_at ORDER BY r.played_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT 'rta_match_participant' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM public.rta_match_participant WHERE replay_id = #{rid} UNION ALL SELECT 'rta_match_unit_pick' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick WHERE replay_id = #{rid}
mapper.insert: WITH deleted AS ( DELETE FROM public.rta_agg_monster_unit x USING public.rta_season s WHERE x.season_id = s.season_id AND s.season_code = #{seasonCode} RETURNING 1 ) INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_monster_unit ( season_id, rating_id, unit_master_id, pick_cnt, ban_cnt, win_cnt, first_pick_cnt ) SELECT s.season_id, 0, u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT u.is_banned)::bigint, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.is_banned)::bigint, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT u.is_banned AND mp.is_winner)::bigint, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT u.is_banned AND u.pick_slot_no = 1)::bigint FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u INNER JOIN public.rta_match m ON u.replay_id = m.replay_id INNER JOIN public.rta_season s ON s.season_id = m.season_id INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant mp ON mp.replay_id = u.replay_id AND mp.wizard_id = u.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster mo ON mo.monster_id = u.unit_master_id::text WHERE s.season_code = #{seasonCode} AND m.played_at >= #{seasonStart} AND m.played_at < #{seasonEnd} AND mo.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.season_id, u.unit_master_id ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, unit_master_id) DO UPDATE SET pick_cnt = EXCLUDED.pick_cnt, ban_cnt = EXCLUDED.ban_cnt, win_cnt = EXCLUDED.win_cnt, first_pick_cnt = EXCLUDED.first_pick_cnt
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.rta_match m INNER JOIN public.rta_season s ON s.season_id = m.season_id WHERE s.season_code = #{seasonCode}

SELECT ps.unit_master_id::text AS monster_id, m.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental, m.kr_name AS monster_name, AS monster_image, ps.pick_cnt AS pick_count, ROUND((ps.pick_cnt::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric FROM public.rta_match mm INNER JOIN public.rta_season ss ON ss.season_id = mm.season_id WHERE ss.season_code = #{seasonCode}), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS pick_rate, CASE WHEN ps.pick_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(ps.win_cnt, 0)::numeric / ps.pick_cnt * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS win_rate, CASE WHEN ps.pick_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND((ps.first_pick_cnt::numeric / ps.pick_cnt * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS first_pick_rate, ROUND((COALESCE(ps.ban_cnt, 0)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric FROM public.rta_match mm INNER JOIN public.rta_season ss ON ss.season_id = mm.season_id WHERE ss.season_code = #{seasonCode}), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS ban_rate FROM public.rta_agg_monster_unit ps INNER JOIN public.rta_season rs ON rs.season_id = ps.season_id LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = ps.unit_master_id::text WHERE rs.season_code = #{seasonCode} AND ps.rating_id = 0 AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND ps.pick_cnt > 0 ORDER BY ps.pick_cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) AS monster_id_1, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) AS monster_id_2, m1.kr_name AS monster_name_1, m2.kr_name AS monster_name_2, AS monster_image_1, AS monster_image_2, m1.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_1, m2.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_2, s.match_cnt AS match_count, ROUND((s.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(s.match_cnt, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS win_rate FROM public.rta_agg_synergy_combo s LEFT JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) LEFT JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) WHERE s.combo_size = 2 AND s.rating_id = 0 AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (s.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(s.match_cnt, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST, s.match_cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) AS monster_id_1, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) AS monster_id_2, split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 3) AS monster_id_3, m1.kr_name AS monster_name_1, m2.kr_name AS monster_name_2, m3.kr_name AS monster_name_3, AS monster_image_1, AS monster_image_2, AS monster_image_3, m1.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_1, m2.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_2, m3.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_3, s.match_cnt AS match_count, ROUND((s.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(s.match_cnt, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS win_rate FROM public.rta_agg_synergy_combo s LEFT JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) LEFT JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) LEFT JOIN public.monster m3 ON m3.monster_id = split_part(s.combo_unit_key, ',', 3) WHERE s.combo_size = 3 AND s.rating_id = 0 AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m3.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (s.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(s.match_cnt, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST, s.match_cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH , match_count AS ( SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint as total_matches FROM rta_match_in_season r ), pick_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental as monster_elemental, m.kr_name as monster_name, as monster_image, COUNT(*) as pick_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN u.pick_slot_no = 1 THEN 1 END) as first_pick_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = u.unit_master_id::text WHERE m.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name ), ban_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) as ban_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u.is_banned = true AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id ), win_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) as win_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON u.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND u.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE ul.is_winner = true AND NOT u.is_banned AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id ) SELECT ps.unit_master_id as monster_id, ps.monster_elemental, ps.monster_name, ps.monster_image, ps.pick_count, ROUND((ps.pick_count::numeric / mc.total_matches * 100)::numeric, 2) as pick_rate, CASE WHEN ps.pick_count > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(ws.win_count, 0)::numeric / ps.pick_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, CASE WHEN ps.pick_count > 0 THEN ROUND((ps.first_pick_count::numeric / ps.pick_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as first_pick_rate, ROUND((COALESCE(bs.ban_count, 0)::numeric / mc.total_matches * 100)::numeric, 2) as ban_rate FROM pick_stats ps CROSS JOIN match_count mc LEFT JOIN ban_stats bs ON ps.unit_master_id = bs.unit_master_id LEFT JOIN win_stats ws ON ps.unit_master_id = ws.unit_master_id LIMIT 1

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r0 ON u1.replay_id = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), opponent_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as opponent_monster_id, m.monster_elemental as opponent_monster_elemental, m.kr_name as opponent_monster_name, as opponent_monster_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ul1.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul1 ON mm.replay_id = ul1.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul1.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul2 ON mm.replay_id = ul2.replay_id AND u2.wizard_id = ul2.wizard_id AND ul1.wizard_id != ul2.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) SELECT opponent_monster_id as monster_id, opponent_monster_elemental as monster_elemental, opponent_monster_name as monster_name, opponent_monster_image as monster_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM opponent_stats ORDER BY win_rate DESC, match_count DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r0 ON u1.replay_id = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), combo_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as combo_monster_id, m.monster_elemental as combo_monster_elemental, m.kr_name as combo_monster_name, as combo_monster_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ul.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON mm.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) SELECT combo_monster_id as monster_id, combo_monster_elemental as monster_elemental, combo_monster_name as monster_name, combo_monster_image as monster_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM combo_stats ORDER BY win_rate DESC, match_count DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( -- 내가 사용한 매치들 SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r0 ON u1.replay_id = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), triple_combo_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as monster1_id, m1.monster_elemental as monster1_elemental, m1.kr_name as monster1_name, as monster1_image, u3.unit_master_id as monster2_id, m2.monster_elemental as monster2_elemental, m2.kr_name as monster2_name, as monster2_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ul.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u3 ON mm.replay_id = u3.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u3.wizard_id JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON mm.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text LEFT JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = u3.unit_master_id::text WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND u3.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND u2.unit_master_id < u3.unit_master_id AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m1.monster_elemental, m1.kr_name, u3.unit_master_id, m2.monster_elemental, m2.kr_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) SELECT monster1_id, monster1_elemental, monster1_name, monster1_image, monster2_id, monster2_elemental, monster2_name, monster2_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM triple_combo_stats ORDER BY win_rate DESC, match_count DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.replay_id, u1.wizard_id, r.date_add FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u1.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ORDER BY r.date_add DESC LIMIT 20 ), my_team_json AS ( SELECT mm.replay_id, mm.wizard_id, json_agg( json_build_object( 'monster_id', u1.unit_master_id, 'monster_name', COALESCE(m1.kr_name, ''), 'monster_image', COALESCE(, '') ) ORDER BY u1.pick_slot_no ) as my_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u1 ON mm.replay_id = u1.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = u1.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = u1.unit_master_id::text GROUP BY mm.replay_id, mm.wizard_id ), opponent_team_json AS ( SELECT mm.replay_id, json_agg( json_build_object( 'monster_id', u2.unit_master_id, 'monster_name', COALESCE(m2.kr_name, ''), 'monster_image', COALESCE(, '') ) ORDER BY u2.pick_slot_no ) as opponent_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_unit_pick u2 ON mm.replay_id = u2.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id != u2.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = u2.unit_master_id::text GROUP BY mm.replay_id ) SELECT mm.replay_id as match_id, mm.date_add as match_date, CASE WHEN ul.is_winner THEN 'WIN' ELSE 'LOSE' END as win_lose, COALESCE(mt.my_team::text, '[]') as my_team, COALESCE(ot.opponent_team::text, '[]') as opponent_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN public.rta_match_participant ul ON mm.replay_id = ul.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON mm.replay_id = r.rid LEFT JOIN my_team_json mt ON mm.replay_id = mt.replay_id AND mm.wizard_id = mt.wizard_id LEFT JOIN opponent_team_json ot ON mm.replay_id = ot.replay_id ORDER BY mm.date_add DESC

SELECT MIN(m.played_at::date) AS min_date, MAX(m.played_at::date) AS max_date FROM public.rta_match m WHERE 1 = 1
AND m.played_at >= #{seasonStart} AND m.played_at < #{seasonEnd}

WITH , rank_window AS ( SELECT (MAX(r.date_add)::date - INTERVAL '120 days')::date AS min_date FROM rta_match_in_season r ), rta_match_in_window AS ( SELECT r.rid, r.date_add, r.winner_wizard_id, r.battle_type FROM rta_match_in_season r INNER JOIN rank_window w ON r.date_add::date >= w.min_date ), anchors AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, '3h', INTERVAL '3 hours'), (2, '6h', INTERVAL '6 hours'), (3, '12h', INTERVAL '12 hours'), (4, '3d', INTERVAL '3 days'), (5, '7d', INTERVAL '7 days') ) AS v(sort_order, anchor_key, iv) ), base AS ( SELECT r.date_add, CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) AS score_val, ( CASE WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 5000 THEN 'L' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 4000 THEN 'G' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 3500 THEN 'P' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 3000 THEN 'C' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 2000 THEN 'F' ELSE 'Ch' END ) || CASE WHEN (CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) % 10)::text ELSE '2' END AS tier_key FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_window r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.rating_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 1000 AND TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 ), tiers AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('G3'), ('G2'), ('G1'), ('P3'), ('P2'), ('P1') ) AS tv(tier_key) ) SELECT a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, t.tier_key, COALESCE(MIN(b.score_val), 0)::bigint AS cutoff_score FROM anchors a CROSS JOIN tiers t LEFT JOIN base b ON b.tier_key = t.tier_key AND b.date_add >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - a.iv AND b.date_add <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, a.iv, t.tier_key ORDER BY a.sort_order, t.tier_key
SELECT sort_order, anchor_key, tier_key, cutoff_score FROM public.rta_rank_cutoff_anchor_snap ORDER BY sort_order, tier_key

WITH SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.wizard_id) u.wizard_id FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 ORDER BY u.wizard_id, r.date_add DESC ) t

WITH , , latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.wizard_id) u.wizard_id, u.wizard_name, u.country_code AS country, u.channel_uid, CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) AS score, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(u.rating_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) ELSE NULL END AS rating_id, r.date_add AS last_match_at FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 ORDER BY u.wizard_id, r.date_add DESC ), ranked AS ( SELECT latest.wizard_id, latest.wizard_name, latest.country, latest.channel_uid, latest.score, latest.rating_id, latest.last_match_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY latest.score DESC, latest.wizard_id ASC) AS rank_position FROM latest ), page_ranked AS ( SELECT * FROM ranked ORDER BY rank_position LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ), field_pick_counts AS ( SELECT u.wizard_id, TRIM(BOTH FROM u.unit_master_id::text) AS unit_master_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS pick_count FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick u WHERE TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(u.unit_master_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND NOT u.is_banned AND u.wizard_id IN (SELECT wizard_id FROM page_ranked) GROUP BY u.wizard_id, TRIM(BOTH FROM u.unit_master_id::text) ), ranked_monsters AS ( SELECT wizard_id, unit_master_id, pick_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY wizard_id ORDER BY pick_count DESC, CAST(unit_master_id AS BIGINT) ASC ) AS rn FROM field_pick_counts ), most1 AS ( SELECT wizard_id, unit_master_id AS m1_id, pick_count AS m1_pick FROM ranked_monsters WHERE rn = 1 ), most2 AS ( SELECT wizard_id, unit_master_id AS m2_id, pick_count AS m2_pick FROM ranked_monsters WHERE rn = 2 ), most3 AS ( SELECT wizard_id, unit_master_id AS m3_id, pick_count AS m3_pick FROM ranked_monsters WHERE rn = 3 ) SELECT pr.rank_position, pr.wizard_id, pr.wizard_name, pr.country, pr.channel_uid, pr.score, pr.rating_id, pr.last_match_at, COALESCE(wa.match_count, 0)::bigint AS match_count, COALESCE(wa.win_count, 0)::bigint AS win_count, m1.m1_id::text AS most_monster_1_id, m1.m1_pick AS most_monster_1_pick_count, COALESCE(mm1.kr_name, '') AS most_monster_1_name, COALESCE(, '') AS most_monster_1_image, m2.m2_id::text AS most_monster_2_id, m2.m2_pick AS most_monster_2_pick_count, COALESCE(mm2.kr_name, '') AS most_monster_2_name, COALESCE(, '') AS most_monster_2_image, m3.m3_id::text AS most_monster_3_id, m3.m3_pick AS most_monster_3_pick_count, COALESCE(mm3.kr_name, '') AS most_monster_3_name, COALESCE(, '') AS most_monster_3_image FROM page_ranked pr LEFT JOIN win_agg wa ON pr.wizard_id = wa.wizard_id LEFT JOIN most1 m1 ON pr.wizard_id = m1.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster mm1 ON m1.m1_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM m1.m1_id::text) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND mm1.monster_id = TRIM(BOTH FROM m1.m1_id::text) LEFT JOIN most2 m2 ON pr.wizard_id = m2.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster mm2 ON m2.m2_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM m2.m2_id::text) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND mm2.monster_id = TRIM(BOTH FROM m2.m2_id::text) LEFT JOIN most3 m3 ON pr.wizard_id = m3.wizard_id LEFT JOIN public.monster mm3 ON m3.m3_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM m3.m3_id::text) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND mm3.monster_id = TRIM(BOTH FROM m3.m3_id::text) ORDER BY pr.rank_position

WITH , , latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.wizard_id) u.wizard_id, u.wizard_name, u.country_code AS country, u.channel_uid, CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) AS score, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(u.rating_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) ELSE NULL END AS rating_id, r.date_add AS last_match_at FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 ORDER BY u.wizard_id, r.date_add DESC ), ranked AS ( SELECT latest.wizard_id, latest.wizard_name, latest.country, latest.channel_uid, latest.score, latest.rating_id, latest.last_match_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY latest.score DESC, latest.wizard_id ASC) AS rank_position FROM latest ), score_max_agg AS ( SELECT u.wizard_id, MAX(CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT))::int AS max_season_score FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 GROUP BY u.wizard_id ) SELECT r.rank_position, r.wizard_id, r.wizard_name, r.country, r.channel_uid, r.score, r.rating_id, r.last_match_at, COALESCE(wa.match_count, 0)::bigint AS match_count, COALESCE(wa.win_count, 0)::bigint AS win_count, COALESCE(sm.max_season_score, r.score)::int AS max_season_score, CASE WHEN COALESCE(wa.match_count, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(wa.win_count, 0)::numeric / wa.match_count::numeric, 1) ELSE NULL END AS win_rate_pct FROM ranked r LEFT JOIN win_agg wa ON r.wizard_id = wa.wizard_id LEFT JOIN score_max_agg sm ON r.wizard_id = sm.wizard_id WHERE TRIM(BOTH FROM r.wizard_id::text) = TRIM(BOTH FROM #{wizardId}) LIMIT 1
